{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print(f"Unique sites: {unique_sites}")

# Compute response rate per site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rates by site:")
print(response_rates)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rates.max()

print(f"Site with highest response rate: {best_site} ({best_rate:.3f})")"}
